    lr, lc = min(r for r, c in low), min(c for r, c in low)

    # Stack the chosen top object above the lower object, aligning their centers.
    top_height = max(r for r, c in top) - tr + 1
    low_height = max(r for r, c in low) - lr + 1

        out[start + r - tr][c + shift] = color

        out[start + top_height + r - lr][c + 5 - low_xcenter.__round__()] = 1
